segments.text: Becina's a Microsoft Dynamics partner. We are people business and the way we drive new revenue and grow our business is kind of adding more talent. >> [music] >> The challenges we were facing before we joined BC Talent was inconsistent flow in new talent.

We had to constantly look for new ways and do all the training ourselves. >> Using the Upskill program, we were able to use our own onboarding system and reduce it because we could move a huge part of that process onto the Upskill program.

Using the Upskill program along with the Microsoft brand makes it more attractive for the youth to send their applications in. >> We see the benefit of training with external people that are not within our own organization is that they bring on new perspectives.

Being able to recruit young talent is immensely important for us. >> When they come out of the BC Talent program, they actually had a lot of knowledge and they are pretty self-confident about working and engaging with the customers we have.

>> There's really no barrier not to join the BC Talent program. >> It's a never-ending learning process. There's a bunch of stuff that you can dive into all the time. >> The program will teach you the technical skills about Business Central and the soft skills that you need to be a consultant.

>> In this community, we can lean on each other whenever we need to. >> I definitely felt that there was a lot of support. I can text a colleague from from the US or from Asia and get an answer in no time.

>> [music] >> We have been able to onboard 14 people so far directly from education and we see very very nice results. So, we're definitely going to do this once more. >> In the past, we've been used to just having one or two people coming in and we had to decide whether or not we wanted to hire them.
Suddenly, having the luxury of picking between 150 qualified people has been kind of mind-blowing for us.
